items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview

ctx.x: What kind of things were you playing?

Oh, we were playing beautiful things. We were playing music, and Stitt was playing -- you might say we were young turks, and we were able to play any kind of music, but we added on what they would call 'bebop' if you want to call it that. Right down the street, Charlie Ventura had his band, and had this vocalist Buddy Stewart with him, Kai Winding, Shelly Manne -- I think Buddy Clark was on bass, and we were doing pretty good. During that time, this pianist, Heywood, was in town, playing music up in Milwaukee,…
